title: basic-pitch-rs transcription
description: Notes transcribed by `basic-pitch-rs --json`, with the input, model and parameters that produced them. Version 1 of the layout: fields are only added within a version, so consumers should ignore fields they do not know.

schema_version.description: Version of the document layout. It changes only when a field is removed, renamed or changes meaning.

generator.description: The program that wrote the document.

model.description: The model and how it was run.

name.description: The Basic Pitch model of spotify/basic-pitch (ICASSP 2022).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the ONNX model file, lowercase hexadecimal.

backend.description: Inference engine: tract (pure Rust) or ort (ONNX Runtime).

path.description: The path as given on the command line.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the file, in Hz.

channels.description: Number of channels of the file.

duration_s.description: Duration of the file, in seconds.

codec.description: Short name of the audio codec, such as pcm_s16le, flac, mp3 or aac.

analysis.description: The audio as analyzed by the model.

sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the model input.

samples.description: Number of mono samples given to the model.

resampler.description: Resampler used to reach 22050 Hz, or null when the file was already at that rate.

trim_mode.description: How the model output is trimmed at the end of the file: like spotify/basic-pitch main, or like the 0.4.0 release.

frames.description: Number of frames of the model output (about 86.6 frames per second).

params.description: Parameters of the note decoding and of the MIDI export, named after the command-line flags.

minimum_frequency.description: In Hz, or null for no limit. A value below A0 (27.5 Hz) given on the command line limits nothing and is recorded as null.

maximum_frequency.description: In Hz, or null for no limit. Notes from the key of this frequency upwards are removed, as in Basic Pitch.

bend_offset.description: Added to every pitch bend, in thirds of a semitone. 0 reproduces Python Basic Pitch, whose in-tune notes read +1; -1 centers them on 0.

notes.description: The notes, sorted by start time, then pitch.

note_name.description: Scientific pitch notation with sharps: C4 is MIDI 60, A4 is MIDI 69.

amplitude.description: Mean note activation over the note.

velocity.description: MIDI velocity: round(127 * amplitude), ties to even.

pitch_bends.description: One pitch bend per frame of the note (end_frame - start_frame values; value i applies to frame start_frame + i), in thirds of a semitone relative to pitch, plus params.bend_offset. null when pitch bends are disabled. With bend_offset 0 (the default, identical to Python Basic Pitch), in-tune notes read +1 because the model's pitch contour peaks one bin high (spotify/basic-pitch#87): use --bend-offset -1 to center them on 0.

pitch_bends_semitones.description: The same pitch bends, in semitones (pitch_bends / 3). The +1/3 semitone bias of pitch_bends applies here too.
